input.subject: Re: The two offers on 340 E 51st, 12F
input.bodyText:
Ryan,

My wife and I talked it over. We'd rather take the slightly lower all-cash offer than deal with a mortgage contingency again. Once bitten. If they can close in 45 days we're comfortable.

Call me tomorrow morning and we'll make it official.

Harold

> On Aug 1, 2026, at 3:22 PM, Ryan Martin <ryan.martin@elliman.com> wrote:
>
> Harold - quick recap of where we stand on 340 E 51st, 12F. We have
> two offers in. Offer A is $1,285,000 financed, 20% down, standard
> contingencies. Offer B is $1,255,000 all cash, no mortgage
> contingency, flexible closing. My read is B is the cleaner deal even
> though it's 30k lighter. Let me know which way you're leaning.
>
> Ryan
